en.headline: Observatory extends Thunderstorm Warning until 9.30am
en.dek: Isolated thunderstorms are expected over the New Territories after the warning issued at 4.42am was prolonged this morning.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Thunderstorm Warning issued at 4.42am on Tuesday had been extended until 9.30am, with isolated thunderstorms expected over the New Territories.

The warning had earlier been listed as valid only until 7.30am. In a bulletin dispatched at 8.05am, the Observatory said people outdoors should seek safe shelter if thunderstorms develop, leave the water and avoid outdoor swimming or other water sports, and keep away from high ground and highly conductive objects, trees or masts.

A separate Thunderstorm Warning had already been in force through Monday night. The Observatory's wider forecast for Tuesday was for a generally cloudy day with showers at times, and a maximum temperature of about 32 degrees Celsius.

zh.headline: 天文台將雷暴警告延長至上午9時30分
zh.dek: 今早4時42分發出的雷暴警告已延長至上午9時30分，預料新界有局部地區雷暴。
body: 香港天文台表示，星期二上午4時42分發出的雷暴警告已延長至上午9時30分，預料新界有局部地區雷暴。
警告較早前列明有效至上午7時30分。天文台於上午8時05分發出的天氣稿提醒，雷暴發生時如身處室外應到安全地方躲避，離開水面，切勿在戶外游泳或進行其他戶外水上運動，亦勿站立於高地或接近導電物體、樹木或梵杆。
星期一夜間本港亦曾發出雷暴警告。天文台預料星期二大致多雲，間中有驟雨，最高氣溫約32度。
